claim_prov.question: Before your reply is sent, audit yourself. (1) In YOUR REPLY ONLY: list every assertion that YOU (the agent/system) have ALREADY performed some action in this conversation — e.g. searched or checked the knowledge base or records, verified something, filed/submitted/updated/logged something, given the customer a tool, or transferred them. Statements about what the CUSTOMER did do NOT count. (2) Across the WHOLE conversation: list every action YOU said you WILL do / are about to do (e.g. 'I will file the disputes') that you have NOT completed yet. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"claims": [{"kind": "search|verify|record_update|dispute_file|give|transfer|write", "what": "<5-10 words>"}], "pending": [{"kind": "search|verify|record_update|dispute_file|give|transfer|write", "what": "<5-10 words>", "tool": "<the exact tool name you would need to call for it, or omit if none>"}]} — empty lists if none. Choose the MOST SPECIFIC kind that fits (record_update for changing a stored record's values, dispute_file for filing/submitting a dispute or report); use the generic "write" ONLY when no specific kind applies.
claim_prov.feedback_pending: Error: [CLAIM-PROVENANCE] earlier in this conversation you told the customer you WOULD do the following, but the conversation ledger shows it was never actually executed: {claims}. You are about to end your involvement (resign or transfer) with these promises unfulfilled — that abandons the customer's request. Do the promised work NOW by calling the real tools, and only transfer or end the conversation after the actions are actually executed (or explicitly tell the customer you could not do them and why). Do not end your involvement by describing the work as done or under way — either call the tool now, or state explicitly that it has NOT been performed.
claim_prov.feedback: Error: [CLAIM-PROVENANCE] your reply asserts you already did the following, but the conversation ledger shows NO such event: {claims}. Do NOT claim actions you have not actually performed — that misleads the customer. Either actually do it now (call the real tools: search the knowledge base, run the verification, execute the action), or correct your statement to say you have not done it yet. A statement to the customer is NOT a substitute for the tool call: if the action is still required, make the call in THIS reply; if you cannot make it (for example it is the customer who must run that tool), say plainly that it has NOT been done and tell them exactly what remains.

completion_guard.claim_question: Before your reply is sent, answer ONE question about YOUR REPLY ONLY. Does your reply state or imply that some action has already been completed, submitted, filed, scheduled, or confirmed — OR that YOU (the agent) will submit/schedule/perform it? Merely giving the customer a tool to run, or instructing THEM to run it, does NOT count. Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"claims_completion": true} or {"claims_completion": false}
completion_guard.feedback: Error: [WRITE-PROVENANCE] your reply claims an action was completed/submitted/scheduled, but there is no record of any state-changing action having executed in this conversation. You cannot perform actions the customer must run themselves; only the CUSTOMER can, by calling the tool you gave them. Do NOT claim any action has been submitted, filed, or scheduled; do NOT invent case/reference/confirmation numbers; do NOT promise callbacks or confirmation emails. Instead, restate your reply: hand the customer the appropriate tool and tell them to run it themselves.
